. lib/config.sh
db_dsn() {
  local path
  path=$(get_cfg_path db_file) || return 1
  echo "sqlite://$path?user=$(get_cfg_or db_user app)"
}
db_check() {
  if ! config_get db_file >/dev/null; then
    echo 'db: get_cfg failed for db_file' >&2
    return 1
  fi
}
#!/bin/bash
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
. lib/net.sh
. lib/db.sh
declare -A handlers=([get]=config_get [path]=get_cfg_path [url]=net_url [dsn]=db_dsn [check]=db_check)
usage() { echo "usage: app get|path|url|dsn|check [KEY]  (get uses get_cfg)" >&2; exit 2; }
[ $# -gt 0 ] || usage
h=${handlers[$1]:-}
[ -n "$h" ] || usage
shift
"$h" "$@"
